ThingDef.label: HFSV-40 "Landwhale" heavy ground-effect fire support vehicle
ThingDef.description:
The HFSV-40 "Landwhale" is a heavy ground-effect fire support platform with a long service history, combining fire support, troop transport, and autonomous patrol capabilities. Its primary weapon is a high-power railgun, supported by rotary machine guns and rocket pods, allowing it to engage heavy armor, close-range infantry, and large clustered targets at the same time. Its powerful hover system lets it cross ravines, shallow water, ruins, and ordinary ground obstacles while maintaining mobility in the harsh environments of many different rimworlds.

As a common multipurpose platform in corporate colonial systems, the Landwhale was designed for the rapid development - official documents insist on that word - of unfamiliar planets. Its built-in autonomous combat AI can independently search for targets, plan routes, and operate every weapon system without a crew, though the manufacturer explicitly refuses liability for any friendly-fire incidents.

In a corporate promotional film, a Landwhale carries an engineering team across a river valley and settles slowly in front of a new colony.
The narrator says, "No matter how distant the world, we can bring civilization there."
Then the railgun turns off-camera and fires, while the subtitle quietly adds, "The specific definition of civilization is subject to the local corporate charter."

ThingDef.label: destroyed Landwhale
ThingDef.description: The wreckage of a downed HFSV-40 "Landwhale", a heavy ground-effect fire support platform with a long service history. Its frame is ruined, but traces of its railgun, rotary machine guns, rocket pods, hover system, transport bay, and autonomous combat AI remain intact enough to investigate or rebuild.\n\nCorporate colonial records describe the Landwhale as a multipurpose platform for the rapid development - official documents insist on that word - of unfamiliar planets. The manufacturer explicitly refuses liability for any friendly-fire incidents.

li.completedLetterLabel: Landwhale wreck analyzed: heavy hover platform theory available
li.completedLetter: By analyzing the destroyed Landwhale, {PAWN_labelShort} has recovered enough combat and lift-system data to make heavy hover platform theory research possible.\n\nYour researchers can now begin the project from the Defensive Network research tab once its normal prerequisites are met.
li.inspectString: Can be analyzed by a colonist.
